spanglish: do you cancel my old service?
meaning_en: Logistics question = near-close. They're thinking about switching.
coaching_en: 🟢 Near CLOSE — They're thinking logistics. Help them through it.
responses_es: Usted puede llamar a cancelar después de que ya tenga nuestro servicio funcionando. Es muy fácil.

triggers_es: estoy contento con lo que tengo
spanglish: i'm happy with what I have
meaning_en: Satisfied with current provider. Hard to move unless you find a hook.
coaching_en: Ask what they pay. Often you can beat the price even if service is ok.
responses_es: Me alegro que tenga buen servicio. Solo por curiosidad, ¿cuánto paga al mes? A veces la gente se sorprende de lo que se puede ahorrar.
